about: Hello! I'm Muhammed Sabith (Sabith Amjadi), a passionate Graphic Designer & Creative Head from India with professional experience in Oman, Sharjah, Kolkata, and Imtibish Corporate. I specialize in creating clean, compelling, and modern visual designs that communicate clearly and inspire action. I focus on branding, social media design, visual identity, publication layout, motion graphics, and luxury packaging. My goal is to craft impactful visual experiences that help brands elevate their presence and connect with their audience effectively.
hero_quote: Reading for the details, doodling in the margins. Designing with intent, crafting identity in every detail.

services.title: Branding & Visual Systems
services.description: Crafting timeless logos, comprehensive brand guidelines, color harmony systems, and complete corporate stationery that give brands an unmistakable presence.

services.title: Editorial & Packaging Design
services.description: Designing multi-fold corporate brochures, student handbooks, broadsheet newspaper layouts, and luxury dieline packaging boxes with intricate detailing.

services.title: Advertising & Social Campaigns
services.description: Creating viral social media creatives, high-impact conference posters, motion reels, promotional videos, and targeted marketing collateral.

work_experience.description: Leading creative direction, holistic brand identity overhauls, high-profile convocation graphics, multi-channel advertising campaigns, and institutional design strategy.
Executed corporate identities, brochures, investor presentations, and multi-market marketing collaterals with strict brand guideline fidelity.
Produced commercial advertisements, luxury packaging mockups, social media campaigns, and large-format print layouts for GCC business clients.
Designed health camp campaigns, clinic promotion posters, educational prospectuses, and community awareness collateral.
Partnered with over 30+ regional and international brands for custom logotypes, editorial handbooks, and creative packaging.
